title: Relationship Deferral Within the Kestrel Return Balance Plan
content:
**Relationship note.** On a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, a customer whose other Kestrel accounts are current has part of the return balance payment moved to the later installments of the plan:

| Customer holds | Amount of the return balance payment moved to the later installments |
|---|---|
| Both an active **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease** showing 0 days past due and an active **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** showing 0 days past due | USD 100.00 |
| Only one of those two: such a lease, or such a new-vehicle retail contract | USD 50.00 |
| Neither | None |

The records read are the status and days past due of the customer's leases and new-vehicle retail contracts. An account showing any days past due, or not in active status, does not count. A pre-owned retail contract does not enter this note.

*Hypothetical:* an active lease at 0 days past due and an active new-vehicle retail contract at 12 days past due: USD 50.00 is moved.
